<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="vi" style="--bg: #F2F8FC; --bg-soft: #E9F1F8; --card-bg: #FFFFFF; --text: #1C2333; --text-soft: #7A8091; --primary: #E44D26; --primary-hover: #C93A17; --primary-soft: #FDEBE6; --border: #E3EDF6; --header-bg: #FFFFFF; --nav-bg: #FFFFFF; --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(28,35,51,.05), 0 8px 22px rgba(28,35,51,.07); --radius: 12px; --ok: #1A9E57; --ok-soft: #E6F7EE; --warn: #F5A623; --danger: #E5484D; --danger-soft: #FDECEC; --reader-font: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, &quot;Segoe UI&quot;, Roboto, sans-serif; --reader-font-size: 17px; --reader-line-height: 1.8; --reader-content-width: 760px; --reader-theme: light;"><head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover">
    <meta name="theme-color" content="#F5F6F8">
    <meta name="description" content="Trang đọc truyện online miễn phí với kho truyện đồ sộ: Tiên Hiệp, Kiếm Hiệp, Ngôn Tình, Huyền Huyễn, Trinh Thám. Cập nhật chương mới mỗi ngày.">
    <title>Truyện Online - Đọc truyện miễn phí, cập nhật nhanh</title>
    <link rel="icon" href="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 64 64'%3E%3Crect width='64' height='64' rx='14' fill='%23E44D26'/%3E%3Ctext x='32' y='42' font-size='26' font-family='Arial' font-weight='bold' fill='white' text-anchor='middle'%3EC2%3C/text%3E%3C/svg%3E">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="index.css">
  <meta name="keywords" content="đọc truyện, truyện online, truyện tiên hiệp, truyện ngôn tình, truyện kiếm hiệp"><link rel="canonical" href="http://localhost:8000/index.html"></head>
  <body>
    <div id="app">
      <div id="header-slot">
    <header class="app-header">
      <div class="hd-left"><button id="header-back-btn" type="button" aria-label="Quay lại" title="Quay lại" class="hd-icon"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="20" height="20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M19 12H5"></path><polyline points="12 19 5 12 12 5"></polyline></svg></button></div>
      <div class="hd-title">Chi tiết truyện</div>
      <div class="hd-right"><button id="header-theme-btn" class="hd-icon" type="button" aria-label="Chuyển sáng/tối"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"></path></svg></button><button id="header-menu-btn" class="hd-icon" type="button" aria-label="Cài đặt"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="18" height="18" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="3"></circle><path d="M19.4 15a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33 1.82l.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83 2.83l-.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82-.33 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1 1.51V21a2 2 0 1 1-4 0v-.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 9 19.4a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.82.33l-.06.06a2 2 0 1 1-2.83-2.83l.06-.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 .33-1.82 1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51-1H3a2 2 0 1 1 0-4h.09A1.65 1.65 0 0 0 4.6 9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33-1.82l-.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83-2.83l.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82.33H9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1-1.51V3a2 2 0 1 1 4 0v.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1 1.51 1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.82-.33l.06-.06a2 2 0 1 1 2.83 2.83l-.06.06a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-.33 1.82V9a1.65 1.65 0 0 0 1.51 1H21a2 2 0 1 1 0 4h-.09a1.65 1.65 0 0 0-1.51 1z"></path></svg></button></div>

      <main id="content">

    <div id="menu-slot"><div class="sheet-overlay reader-menu-overlay"><div class="sheet reader-menu-sheet"><div class="sheet-grip"></div><div class="sheet-head">Tùy chỉnh đọc</div><div class="settings-panel">
        <section class="set-card">
          <h3 class="set-card-title">Giao diện</h3>
          <p class="set-label">Theme</p>
          <div class="theme-row">
            
              <button type="button" class="set-theme active" data-theme="light">Sáng</button>
            
              <button type="button" class="set-theme" data-theme="sepia">Nâu</button>
            
              <button type="button" class="set-theme" data-theme="dark">Tối</button>
            
              <button type="button" class="set-theme" data-theme="amoled">AMOLED</button>
            
          </div>
          
        <div class="set-row toggle-row">
          <div class="toggle-text">
            <span class="set-label">Ẩn thanh công cụ khi đọc</span>
            <span class="set-desc">Tự ẩn topbar &amp; nút điều hướng</span>
          </div>
          <label class="switch">
            <input type="checkbox" data-toggle="hideToolbar" checked="">
            <span class="switch-slider"></span>
          </label>
        </div>
        <div class="set-row toggle-row">
          <div class="toggle-text">
            <span class="set-label">Tự lưu vị trí đọc</span>

              <option value="mặc định">Mặc định</option><option value="serif">Serif</option>
            </select>

        </div>
        </section></div></div></div><div class="reader-menu-overlay toc-overlay" style="background: var(--overlay, rgba(28,35,51,.45));"><div class="reader-menu-sheet toc-sheet" style="background: var(--card-bg, #ffffff); color: var(--text, #2C2C2C); border-radius: 16px 16px 0px 0px; box-shadow: var(--shadow, 0 -4px 24px rgba(20,28,48,.12));"><div class="reader-menu-grip" style="background: var(--border, #e6e1d5);"></div><p class="reader-menu-label" style="margin: 0px 0px 8px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.6px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-soft, #777777);">Mục lục</p><div class="toc-list"></div></div></div><div class="ad-popover">
    <div class="ad-pop-card">
      <span class="ad-pop-fire">🔥 TOP 1 BÁN CHẠY</span>
      <div class="ad-pop-tagline">Quà tặng hấp dẫn kèm theo khi bạn ủng hộ nhóm dịch</div>
      <h3 class="ad-pop-title">Mở Khóa Chương Truyện</h3>
      <p class="ad-pop-msg" id="ad-pop-msg">Mời quý độc giả Click vào banner hoặc link để ủng hộ nhóm dịch và tiếp tục đọc chương này miễn phí. Cảm ơn mọi người rất nhiều!</p>
      <div class="ad-pop-links" id="ad-pop-links"></div>
      <p class="ad-pop-hint">Click 1 lần để mở khóa toàn bộ chương truyện.</p>
      <button type="button" class="ad-pop-close" id="ad-pop-close">Đóng — đọc tiếp chương</button>
    </div>

    <script type="module">
      // [Nhiệm vụ: Ghép nối các mô-đun — điều hướng 5 tab, trang chủ, chi tiết, tìm kiếm nâng cao, thư viện 4 tab, lịch sử, cài đặt, khung đọc với mục lục + popup quảng cáo affiliate]
      // [Đường dẫn: inline trong /index.html]
      // [Khi nào mở: Sửa luồng điều hướng, kết nối dữ liệu/admin hoặc thay đổi cách kết nối các màn hình]

      // ---------- Import mô-đun ----------
      import { Theme } from './config/theme.js'
      import { SiteConfig, AD_CHAPTERS } from './config/siteConfig.js'
      import { ReaderLogic } from './modules/readerLogic.js'
      import { StoryLogic } from './modules/storyLogic.js'
      import { ApiService } from './services/apiService.js'
      import { StoryStore } from './services/storyStore.js'
      import { renderHeader, renderReaderHeader, C2_ICONS } from './components/Header.js'
      import { renderBottomNav } from './components/BottomNav.js'
      import { renderStoryCard, renderStoryGrid, renderStoryListRow, renderLibraryRow, renderHistoryRow, formatViews, chapterCount } from './components/StoryCard.js'
      import { createReaderViewer } from './components/ReaderViewer.js'
      import { createReaderMenu } from './components/ReaderMenu.js'
      import { createReaderToc } from './components/ReaderToc.js'
      import { createSettingsPanel } from './components/SettingsPanel.js'
      import { createAdPopover } from './components/AdPopover.js'

      // ---------- Dữ liệu (nguồn chung với admin) ----------
      StoryStore.init()
      StoryStore.publish()
      const SAMPLE_STORIES = StoryStore.list({ public: true })
      const STORY_MAP = new Map(StoryStore.list().map((s) => [String(s.id), s]))
      window.addEventListener('pagehide', () => StoryStore.flush())
      document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => { if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') StoryStore.flush() })

      // ---------- Khởi tạo & lấy phần tử ----------
      Theme.init()
      ReaderLogic.init()
      SiteConfig.init()
      SiteConfig.applyToDocument(document)

      const headerSlot = document.getElementById('header-slot')
      const content = document.getElementById('content')
      const navSlot = document.getElementById('nav-slot')
      const menuSlot = document.getElementById('menu-slot')

      const readerMenu = createReaderMenu()
      menuSlot.appendChild(readerMenu.el)
      const readerToc = createReaderToc({ onSelect: gotoChapter })
      menuSlot.appendChild(readerToc.el)
      const adPopover = createAdPopover()
      menuSlot.appendChild(adPopover.el)

      const viewer = createReaderViewer({ onPrev: prevChapter, onNext: nextChapter, onToc: () => readerToc.open(currentStory, currentChapterIndex) })

      // ---------- Trạng thái ----------
      let currentTab = 'home'
      let sourceTab = 'home'
      let currentStory = null
      let currentChapterIndex = 0
      let readerActive = false
      let pendingRestoreRatio = 0
      let readerHeaderTitleEl = null
      let readerThemeBtn = null
      let adsShown = new Set()
      let lastScrollTop = 0
      let pendingAutoNext = null

      // ---------- Header helper ----------
      function themeBtnHtml() {
        return `<button id="header-theme-btn" class="hd-icon" type="button" aria-label="Chuyển sáng/tối">${Theme.isDark() ? C2_ICONS.sun : C2_ICONS.moon}</button>`
      }
      const GEAR_HTML = `<button id="header-menu-btn" class="hd-icon" type="button" aria-label="Cài đặt">${C2_ICONS.gear}</button>`
      const HEADER_RIGHT = () => themeBtnHtml() + GEAR_HTML

      function setHeader(html, { onBack = null, onMenu = null } = {}) {
        headerSlot.innerHTML = html
        const back = headerSlot.querySelector('#header-back-btn')
        if (back) back.addEventListener('click', onBack || (() => switchTab(sourceTab)))
        const menu = headerSlot.querySelector('#header-menu-btn')
        if (menu) menu.addEventListener('click', onMenu || (() => switchTab('settings')))
        const theme = headerSlot.querySelector('#header-theme-btn')
        if (theme) theme.addEventListener('click', toggleAppTheme)
      }

      function toggleAppTheme() {
        Theme.setTheme(Theme.isDark() ? 'light' : 'dark')
        const btn = headerSlot.querySelector('#header-theme-btn')
        if (btn) btn.innerHTML = Theme.isDark() ? C2_ICONS.sun : C2_ICONS.moon
      }

      // ---------- Helpers ----------
      function escAttr(v) {
        return String(v ?? '').replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/"/g, '&quot;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
      }
      // Render văn án: tách \n thành các đoạn <p> (dòng trống = ngắt đoạn, \n đơn = xuống dòng <br>)
      function paragraphHtml(desc, fallback = 'Chưa có mô tả.') {
        const src = String(desc || '').trim()
        if (!src) return `<p>${escAttr(fallback)}</p>`
        const paras = []
        let buf = []
        src.split(/\r?\n/).forEach((ln) => {
          const t = ln.trim()
          if (!t) {
            if (buf.length) { paras.push(buf); buf = [] }
          } else {
            buf.push(escAttr(t))
          }
        })
        if (buf.length) paras.push(buf)
        if (!paras.length) paras.push([escAttr(fallback)])
        return paras.map((p) => `<p>${p.join('<br>')}</p>`).join('')
      }
      // Icon bookmark (đặc đặc khi đã lưu) — nút "Thêm thư viện" ở trang chi tiết
      function bookmarkIcon(filled = false) {
        return `<svg class="lib-bookmark" viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="16" height="16" fill="${filled ? 'currentColor' : 'none'}" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M6 3h12a1 1 0 0 1 1 1v17l-7-4-7 4V4a1 1 0 0 1 1-1z"/></svg>`
      }
      // Icon tủ sách — trạng thái trống của Thư viện
      function shelfIcon() {
        return '<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="48" height="48" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 4v16M20 4v16M4 8h16M4 13h16M4 18h16"/><path d="M7 6h2M11 6h2M15 6h2M7 11h2M11 11h2M15 11h2M7 16h2M11 16h2M15 16h2"/></svg>'
      }
      function shuffle(arr) {
        const a = [...arr]
        for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
          const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1))
          ;[a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]]
        }
        return a
      }
      function withChapterBadge(story) {
        if (story.latestChapter) return story
        return { ...story, latestChapter: chapterCount(story) ? String(chapterCount(story)) : '' }
      }
      function chapterTitleInfo(ch) {
        const m = String(ch ? ch.title : '').match(/^Chương\s+([\dIVXL]+)[\s:：-]*(.*)$/i)
        if (m) return { num: 'Chương ' + m[1], sub: (m[2] || '').trim() }
        return { num: ch ? ch.title : '', sub: '' }
      }
      function emptyState(title, desc, { icon = '' } = {}) {
        return `<div class="empty-state">${icon ? `<div class="empty-icon">${icon}</div>` : ''}<p class="empty-title">${title}</p><p class="empty-desc">${desc}</p></div>`
      }

      function wireStoryClicks(container, openFn = openStory) {
        container.querySelectorAll('[data-id]').forEach((el) => {
          el.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const story = STORY_MAP.get(String(el.dataset.id))
            if (story) openFn(story.id)
          })
        })
      }
      function getInterestedGenres() {
        const ids = new Set()
        ;[...ReaderLogic.getLibrary().map((e) => e.id), ...ReaderLogic.getHistory().map((h) => h.storyId)].forEach((id) => ids.add(String(id)))
        const genres = new Set()
        ids.forEach((id) => {
          const s = STORY_MAP.get(id)
          if (s) (s.genres || []).forEach((g) => genres.add(g))
        })
        return [...genres]
      }

      // ================= TRANG CHỦ =================
      // Khung slider ngang dùng chung cho "Phổ biến" và "Đề xuất" (13 truyện / đề xuất)
      function railBlock(cardsHtml) {
        return `<div class="hrail-wrap">
          <button type="button" class="rail-arrow rail-prev" aria-label="Lùi" hidden>&#8249;</button>
          <div class="hrail">${cardsHtml}</div>
          <button type="button" class="rail-arrow rail-next" aria-label="Tiến" hidden>&#8250;</button>
        </div>`
      }
      function wireRailScroll(scope) {
        if (scope._railWired) return
        scope._railWired = true
        scope.querySelectorAll('.hrail-wrap').forEach((wrap) => {
          const rail = wrap.querySelector('.hrail')
          const card = rail.querySelector('.story-card')
          const step = () => ((card ? card.getBoundingClientRect().width + 10 : 354) * 3)
          const prev = wrap.querySelector('.rail-prev')
          const next = wrap.querySelector('.rail-next')
          const upd = () => {
            prev.hidden = rail.scrollLeft < 8
            next.hidden = rail.scrollLeft + rail.clientWidth >= rail.scrollWidth - 1
          }
          prev.addEventListener('click', () => rail.scrollBy({ left: -step(), behavior: 'smooth' }))
          next.addEventListener('click', () => rail.scrollBy({ left: step(), behavior: 'smooth' }))
          rail.addEventListener('scroll', upd, { passive: true })
          rail.addEventListener('scrollend', upd, { passive: true })
          upd()
        })
      }

      async function showHome() {
        currentTab = 'home'
        renderNav('home')
        setHeader(renderHeader({ brand: true, rightAction: HEADER_RIGHT() }))

        const stories = await ApiService.getStoriesFromLocal(SAMPLE_STORIES)

        const homeEl = document.createElement('div')
        homeEl.className = 'home'
        homeEl.innerHTML = `
          <form class="qs" autocomplete="off">
            <span class="qs-ico">${C2_ICONS.search}</span>
            <input class="qs-input" placeholder="Tìm truyện nhanh..." value="">
            <button type="button" class="qs-clear" hidden aria-label="Xóa">&#10005;</button>
          </form>
        `

        const popular = StoryLogic.sort(stories, 'views').slice(0, 13)
        const updated = StoryLogic.sort(stories, 'latest').slice(0, 30)
        const suggest = StoryLogic.recommend(stories, { genres: getInterestedGenres(), limit: 13 })

        homeEl.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `
          <section class="sec">
            <div class="sec-head"><h2>Phổ biến</h2></div>
            ${railBlock(popular.map((s) => renderStoryCard(withChapterBadge(s))).join(''))}
          </section>
          <section class="sec">
            <div class="sec-head"><h2>Mới Cập Nhật</h2></div>
            <div class="stack">${updated.map((s) => renderStoryListRow(withChapterBadge(s))).join('')}</div>
          </section>
          ${suggest.length ? `
          <section class="sec">
            <div class="sec-head"><h2>Đề Xuất</h2></div>
            ${railBlock(suggest.map((s) => renderStoryCard(withChapterBadge(s))).join(''))}
          </section>` : ''}
        `)

        content.innerHTML = ''
        content.appendChild(homeEl)

        // Tìm kiếm nhanh
        const qs = homeEl.querySelector('.qs')
        const qsInput = qs.querySelector('.qs-input')
        const qsClear = qs.querySelector('.qs-clear')
        qs.addEventListener('submit', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); switchTab('search', qsInput.value.trim()) })
        qs.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          if (e.target.closest('.qs-clear')) return
          if (e.target.closest('.qs-ico')) switchTab('search', qsInput.value.trim())
        })
        qsInput.addEventListener('input', () => { qsClear.hidden = !qsInput.value })
        qsClear.addEventListener('click', () => { qsInput.value = ''; qsClear.hidden = true; qsInput.focus() })

        wireStoryClicks(homeEl)
        wireRailScroll(homeEl)
      }

      // ================= TÌM KIẾM NÂNG CAO =================
      function showSearch(initialQuery = '') {
        currentTab = 'search'
        renderNav('search')
        setHeader(renderHeader({ title: 'Tìm kiếm', rightAction: HEADER_RIGHT() }))

        const genres = ['Tất cả thể loại', ...StoryLogic.getGenres(SAMPLE_STORIES)]
        let selGenres = []
        let selStatus = ''
        let selSort = 'views'

        content.innerHTML = `
          <div class="search-page">
            <form class="search-bar" autocomplete="off">
              <span class="sr-ico">${C2_ICONS.search}</span>
              <input type="search" class="search-input" placeholder="Tìm tên truyện..." value="">
              <button type="button" class="qs-clear sr-clear" hidden aria-label="Xóa">&#10005;</button>
            </form>

            <div class="fl-genres genre-chips">
              ${genres.map((g) => `<button type="button" class="chip${g === 'Tất cả thể loại' ? ' active' : ''}" data-genre="${escAttr(g)}">${g}</button>`).join('')}
            </div>

            <div class="fl-status genre-chips">
              ${['Tất cả trạng thái', 'FULL', 'Đang ra'].map((s) => `<button type="button" class="chip${s === 'Tất cả trạng thái' ? ' active' : ''}" data-status="${escAttr(s)}">${s}</button>`).join('')}
            </div>

            <div class="sort-row">
              ${[['rating', 'Đánh giá'], ['views', 'Phổ biến'], ['latest', 'Chương mới'], ['name', 'A-Z']]
                .map(([k, label]) => `<button type="button" class="chip sort-chip${k === selSort ? ' active' : ''}" data-sort="${k}">${label}</button>`).join('')}
            </div>

            <div class="results" id="search-results"></div>
          </div>
        `

        const input = content.querySelector('.search-input')
        const clearBtn = content.querySelector('.sr-clear')
        const results = content.querySelector('#search-results')

        function run() {
          const filtered = StoryLogic.filter(SAMPLE_STORIES, { query: input.value, genres: selGenres, status: selStatus })
          const sorted = StoryLogic.sort(filtered, selSort)
          results.innerHTML = ''
          if (!sorted.length) {
            results.innerHTML = emptyState('Không tìm thấy', 'Thử lại với từ khóa hoặc bộ lọc khác nhé.')
            return
          }
          results.innerHTML = renderStoryGrid(sorted, { showRating: true })
          wireStoryClicks(results)
        }

        content.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
          const g = e.target.closest('[data-genre]')
          if (g) {
            const val = g.dataset.genre
            if (val === 'Tất cả thể loại') {
              selGenres = []
              content.querySelectorAll('.fl-genres .chip').forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle('active', c === g))
            } else {
              const idx = selGenres.indexOf(val)
              if (idx >= 0) selGenres.splice(idx, 1); else selGenres.push(val)
              g.classList.toggle('active')
              content.querySelector('.fl-genres [data-genre="Tất cả thể loại"]')?.classList.remove('active')
            }
            run()
            return
          }
          const st = e.target.closest('[data-status]')
          if (st) {
            selStatus = st.dataset.status === 'Tất cả trạng thái' ? '' : st.dataset.status
            content.querySelectorAll('.fl-status .chip').forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle('active', c === st))
            run()
            return
          }
          const so = e.target.closest('[data-sort]')
          if (so) {
            selSort = so.dataset.sort
            content.querySelectorAll('.sort-chip').forEach((c) => c.classList.toggle('active', c === so))
            run()
          }
        })

        let timer = null
        input.addEventListener('input', () => {
          clearBtn.hidden = !input.value
          clearTimeout(timer)
          timer = setTimeout(run, 200)
        })
        clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { input.value = ''; clearBtn.hidden = true; run(); input.focus() })
        content.querySelector('.search-bar').addEventListener('submit', (e) => { e.preventDefault(); run() })

        if (initialQuery) { input.value = initialQuery; clearBtn.hidden = false }
        run()
        input.focus()
      }

      // ================= THƯ VIỆN (4 tab) =================
      const LIB_TABS = [['all', 'Tất cả'], ['saved', 'Đã lưu'], ['reading', 'Đang đọc'], ['done', 'Hoàn thành']]
      let libTab = 'all'

      function showLibrary() {
        currentTab = 'library'
        renderNav('library')
        setHeader(renderHeader({ title: 'Thư viện', rightAction: HEADER_RIGHT() }))

        const lib = document.createElement('div')
        lib.className = 'lib-page'
        lib.innerHTML = `
          <div class="tab-row">
            ${LIB_TABS.map(([k, label]) => `<button type="button" class="lib-tab${k === libTab ? ' active' : ''}" data-tab="${k}">${label}</button>`).join('')}
          </div>
          <div class="lib-list" id="lib-list"></div>
        `
        content.innerHTML = ''
        content.appendChild(lib)
        renderLib()
        wireLibControls(lib)
      }

      function libFiltered() {
        const entries = ReaderLogic.getLibrary()
        const withProgress = entries.map((e) => ({ entry: e, story: STORY_MAP.get(String(e.id)), prog: ReaderLogic.getProgress(e.id) })).filter((x) => x.story)
        if (libTab === 'all') return withProgress
        if (libTab === 'saved') return withProgress.filter((x) => !x.prog)
        if (libTab === 'reading') return withProgress.filter((x) => x.entry.status === 'reading')
        return withProgress.filter((x) => x.entry.status === 'done')
      }

      function renderLib() {
        const listEl = content.querySelector('#lib-list')
        const items = libFiltered()
        if (!items.length) {
          listEl.innerHTML = emptyState('Chưa có gì trong thư viện', 'Bấm "Thêm thư viện" ở trang truyện.', { icon: shelfIcon() })
          return
        }
        listEl.innerHTML = items.map(({ story, entry, prog }) => {
          const ch = prog ? `Chương ${Math.min(prog.chapterIndex + 1, chapterCount(story))}` : ''
          return renderLibraryRow(withChapterBadge(story), entry, { chapter: ch })
        }).join('')
        listEl.querySelectorAll('.lib-row').forEach((row) => {
          const sid = row.dataset.id
          row.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            if (e.target.closest('.lib-btn')) return
            openStory(sid)
          })
          row.querySelector('[data-act="remove"]').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation()
            ReaderLogic.removeFromLibrary(sid)
            renderLib()
          })
          row.querySelector('[data-act="branch"]').addEventListener('click', (e) => {
            e.stopPropagation()
            const next = row.querySelector('[data-act="branch"]').dataset.status === 'done' ? 'reading' : 'done'
            ReaderLogic.setLibraryStatus(sid, next)
            renderLib()
          })
        })
      }

      function wireLibControls(lib) {
        lib.querySelectorAll('.lib-tab').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            libTab = btn.dataset.tab
            lib.querySelectorAll('.lib-tab').forEach((b) => b.classList.toggle('active', b === btn))
            renderLib()
          })
        })
      }

      // ================= LỊCH SỬ =================
      function showHistory() {
        currentTab = 'history'
        renderNav('history')
        setHeader(renderHeader({ title: 'Lịch sử', rightAction: HEADER_RIGHT() }))

        const hist = document.createElement('div')
        hist.className = 'hist-page'

        const entries = ReaderLogic.getHistory()
          .map((h) => ({ h, story: STORY_MAP.get(String(h.storyId)) }))
          .filter((x) => x.story)

        hist.innerHTML = entries.length ? `
          <div class="hist-actions"><button type="button" class="btn-soft btn-danger-soft" id="hist-clear">Xóa tất cả</button></div>
        ` : ''

        const listEl = document.createElement('div')
        listEl.className = 'lib-list'
        if (!entries.length) {
          listEl.innerHTML = emptyState('Chưa có lịch sử đọc', 'Những truyện bạn từng đọc sẽ xuất hiện ở đây.', { icon: '🕘' })
        } else {
          listEl.innerHTML = entries.map(({ h, story }) => {
            const ch = `Chương ${Math.min(h.chapterIndex + 1, chapterCount(story))}`
            const time = ReaderLogic.formatTime(h.time)
            return renderHistoryRow(withChapterBadge(story), { chapter: ch, time })
          }).join('')
          listEl.querySelectorAll('.lib-row').forEach((row) => {
            row.addEventListener('click', () => openStory(row.dataset.id))
          })
        }
        hist.appendChild(listEl)
        content.innerHTML = ''
        content.appendChild(hist)

        const clearBtn = hist.querySelector('#hist-clear')
        if (clearBtn) {
          clearBtn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (!confirm('Xóa toàn bộ lịch sử đọc?')) return
            ReaderLogic.getHistory().forEach((h) => {
              ReaderLogic.clearProgress(h.storyId)
              ReaderLogic.clearDraft(h.storyId, h.chapterId)
            })
            showHistory()
          })
        }
      }

      // ================= CÀI ĐẶT =================
      let settingsPanel = null
      function showSettings() {
        currentTab = 'settings'
        renderNav('settings')
        setHeader(renderHeader({ title: 'Cài đặt' }))

        content.innerHTML = ''
        settingsPanel = createSettingsPanel({ sections: ['interface', 'reading', 'data'] })
        content.appendChild(settingsPanel.el)
      }

      // ================= TRANG CHI TIẾT TRUYỆN =================
      function openStory(storyId) {
        const story = STORY_MAP.get(String(storyId))
        if (!story) return
        StoryStore.incrementClick(storyId)
        sourceTab = currentTab === 'reader' ? sourceTab : (currentTab === 'detail' ? sourceTab : currentTab)
        currentStory = story
        renderDetail()
      }

      function renderDetail() {
        const story = currentStory
        const isFull = story.status === 'Hoàn thành'
        const nChapter = (story.chapters || []).length
        const prog = ReaderLogic.getProgress(story.id)
        const inLibrary = ReaderLogic.isInLibrary(story.id)
        const resume = prog && prog.chapterIndex > 0

        currentTab = 'detail'
        renderNav(sourceTab)
        setHeader(renderHeader({ title: 'Chi tiết truyện', showBack: true, rightAction: HEADER_RIGHT() }))

        const related = StoryLogic.recommend(SAMPLE_STORIES, { genres: story.genres || [], excludeId: story.id, limit: 5 })

        content.innerHTML = `
          <div class="detail">
            <div class="detail-hero">
              <div class="detail-cover">
                ${story.cover ? `<img src="${story.cover}" alt="${story.title}" />` : '<span class="detail-cover-ph">📗</span>'}
              </div>
              <div class="detail-info">
                <h1 class="dt-title">${story.title}</h1>
                <p class="dt-sub">${escAttr(story.author || 'Tác giả')}</p>
                <div class="dt-tags">
                  ${(story.genres || []).map((g) => `<span class="dt-tag dt-tag-genre">${g}</span>`).join('')}
                  <span class="dt-tag ${isFull ? 'dt-tag-full' : 'dt-tag-hot'}">${isFull ? 'FULL' : 'Đang ra'}</span>
                  <span class="dt-tag dt-tag-rating">★ ${(story.rating || 0).toFixed(1)}</span>
                </div>
                <p class="dt-meta">${formatViews(story.views)} lượt xem · ${nChapter} chương</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div class="detail-actions">
              <button type="button" class="btn-primary" data-act="start">▶ &nbsp;${resume ? 'Đọc tiếp' : 'Đọc từ đầu'}</button>
              <div class="act-row">
                <button type="button" class="btn-soft" data-act="latest">Chương mới nhất</button>
                <button type="button" class="btn-soft" data-act="lib" data-in="${inLibrary}">${bookmarkIcon(inLibrary)} ${inLibrary ? 'Đã lưu' : 'Thêm thư viện'}</button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <section class="sec">
              <div class="sec-head"><h2>Giới thiệu</h2></div>
              <div class="synopsis" id="synopsis">${paragraphHtml(story.description)}</div>
            </section>

            <section class="sec">
              <div class="sec-head"><h2>Danh sách chương</h2><span class="sec-count">${nChapter} chương</span></div>
              <div class="chp-search"><span class="chp-search-ico">${C2_ICONS.search}</span><input type="search" class="chp-input" placeholder="Tìm chương..." /></div>
              <div class="chp-list" id="chp-list"></div>
            </section>

            ${related.length ? `
            <section class="sec">
              <div class="sec-head"><h2>Truyện đề xuất</h2></div>
              <div class="stack" id="related">${related.map((s) => renderStoryListRow(withChapterBadge(s))).join('')}</div>
            </section>` : ''}
          </div>
        `

        // Văn án: đọc thêm / thu gọn
        const syn = content.querySelector('#synopsis')
        if ((story.description || '').length > 90) {
          syn.classList.add('collapsed')
          const toggle = document.createElement('button')
          toggle.type = 'button'
          toggle.className = 'syn-toggle'
          toggle.textContent = 'Đọc thêm'
          syn.parentElement.appendChild(toggle)
          toggle.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const open = syn.classList.toggle('collapsed')
            toggle.textContent = open ? 'Đọc thêm' : 'Thu gọn'
          })
        }

        // Nút hành động
        content.querySelector('[data-act="start"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
          openReader(story.id, resume ? prog.chapterIndex : 0, !!resume)
        })
        content.querySelector('[data-act="latest"]').addEventListener('click', () => {
          openReader(story.id, Math.max(0, nChapter - 1))
        })
        const btnLib = content.querySelector('[data-act="lib"]')
        btnLib.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const saved = ReaderLogic.isInLibrary(story.id)
          if (saved) ReaderLogic.removeFromLibrary(story.id)
          else ReaderLogic.addToLibrary(story)
          btnLib.dataset.in = saved ? 'false' : 'true'
          btnLib.innerHTML = `${bookmarkIcon(!saved)} ${saved ? 'Thêm thư viện' : 'Đã lưu'}`
        })

        // Danh sách chương
        const chpList = content.querySelector('#chp-list')
        function renderChapters(filter = '') {
          const chapters = (story.chapters || []).filter((ch) => ch.title.toLowerCase().includes(filter.toLowerCase()))
          chpList.innerHTML = chapters.map((ch, k) => {
            const globalIndex = (story.chapters || []).indexOf(ch)
            const reading = prog && prog.chapterId === ch.id
            const { num, sub } = chapterTitleInfo(ch)
            return `
              <div class="chp-item" data-chidx="${globalIndex}">
                <span class="chp-idx">${num}</span>
                ${sub ? `<span class="chp-title">${sub}</span>` : ''}
                <span class="chp-state ${reading ? 'on' : ''}">${reading ? 'Đang đọc' : ''}</span>
              </div>
            `
          }).join('') || '<p class="chp-empty">Không tìm thấy chương.</p>'
          chpList.querySelectorAll('.chp-item').forEach((el) => {
            el.addEventListener('click', () => {
              const idx = Number(el.dataset.chidx)
              openReader(story.id, idx, prog && prog.chapterIndex === idx)
            })
          })
        }
        renderChapters()
        content.querySelector('.chp-input').addEventListener('input', (e) => renderChapters(e.target.value))

        wireStoryClicks(content.querySelector('#related'))
      }

      // ================= KHUNG ĐỌC =================
      function openTocSheet() {
        if (!currentStory) return
        readerMenu.close()
        readerToc.open(currentStory, currentChapterIndex)
      }
      function openReaderMenu() {
        readerToc.close()
        readerMenu.open()
      }

      function gotoChapter(i) {
        if (i === currentChapterIndex) { readerToc.close(); return }
        saveReadingState({ asDraft: true })
        currentChapterIndex = i
        renderChapter()
        readerToc.close()
      }

      function toggleReaderTheme() {
        Theme.setTheme(Theme.isDark() ? 'light' : 'dark')
        if (readerThemeBtn) readerThemeBtn.innerHTML = Theme.isDark() ? C2_ICONS.sun : C2_ICONS.moon
      }

      function openReader(storyId, chapterIndex = 0, restoreRatio = false) {
        const story = STORY_MAP.get(String(storyId))
        if (!story || !story.chapters.length) return

        currentStory = story
        currentChapterIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(chapterIndex, story.chapters.length - 1))
        const prog = ReaderLogic.getProgress(story.id)
        pendingRestoreRatio = restoreRatio && prog && prog.chapterIndex === currentChapterIndex ? (prog.scrollRatio || 0) : 0

        readerActive = true
        setHeader(renderReaderHeader({ title: story.title, isDark: Theme.isDark() }), { onMenu: openReaderMenu })

        readerHeaderTitleEl = document.getElementById('reader-header-title')
        readerThemeBtn = document.getElementById('reader-theme-btn')

        document.getElementById('reader-home-btn').addEventListener('click', () => switchTab('home'))
        document.getElementById('reader-back-btn').addEventListener('click', exitReader)
        readerThemeBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleReaderTheme)
        document.getElementById('reader-settings-btn').addEventListener('click', openReaderMenu)
        document.getElementById('reader-menu-btn').addEventListener('click', openTocSheet)

        document.body.classList.add('reading')

        navSlot.innerHTML = ''
        content.innerHTML = ''
        const wrap = document.createElement('div')
        wrap.className = 'reader-wrap'
        wrap.appendChild(viewer.el)
        content.appendChild(wrap)

        lastScrollTop = content.scrollTop
        renderChapter()
      }

      function buildChapterHTML(chapter) {
        return (chapter.paragraphs || []).map((p) => `<p>${p}</p>`).join('')
      }

      // Cuộn ngay lập tức về đầu (hoặc vị trí ratio) khi chuyển chương / vào chương
      // — bỏ qua css scroll-behavior:smooth để không bị "cuộn mượt" làm delay
      function scrollReaderInstantly(ratio = 0) {
        const root = document.documentElement
        const prev = root.style.scrollBehavior
        root.style.scrollBehavior = 'auto'
        window.scrollTo(0, ratio > 0 ? ratio * Math.max(0, root.scrollHeight - window.innerHeight) : 0)
        content.scrollTop = ratio > 0 && content.scrollHeight > content.clientHeight ? ratio * (content.scrollHeight - content.clientHeight) : 0
        root.style.scrollBehavior = prev
      }

      function renderChapter() {
        const story = currentStory
        const chapter = story.chapters[currentChapterIndex]

        if (!chapter) {
          viewer.showError('Không tìm thấy chương này.')
          return
        }

        const info = chapterTitleInfo(chapter)
        viewer.setChapter({
          storyId: story.id,
          title: chapter.title,
          chNum: info.num,
          chSub: info.sub,
          contentHTML: buildChapterHTML(chapter),
          chapterIndex: currentChapterIndex,
          chapterCount: story.chapters.length,
          hasPrev: currentChapterIndex > 0,
          hasNext: currentChapterIndex < story.chapters.length - 1,
        })

        if (readerHeaderTitleEl) readerHeaderTitleEl.textContent = story.title

        // Popup quảng cáo affiliate: chỉ ở chương được cấu hình (2,4,6...), 1 lần/chương
        const ads = SiteConfig.getAd()
        const chNum = currentChapterIndex + 1
        if (ads && AD_CHAPTERS.includes(chNum) && !adsShown.has(chNum)) {
          adsShown.add(chNum)
          adPopover.show({ links: ads })
        }

        scrollReaderInstantly(0)
        document.body.classList.add('chrome-shown')
        if (readerThemeBtn) readerThemeBtn.innerHTML = Theme.isDark() ? C2_ICONS.sun : C2_ICONS.moon

        if (pendingRestoreRatio > 0.02) {
          requestAnimationFrame(() => {
            scrollReaderInstantly(pendingRestoreRatio)
          })
          pendingRestoreRatio = 0
        }
      }

      function currentChapter() {
        return currentStory && currentStory.chapters[currentChapterIndex]
      }

      function scrollRatio() {
        const max = content.scrollHeight - content.clientHeight
        return max > 0 ? Math.min(1, content.scrollTop / max) : 0
      }

      function saveReadingState({ asDraft = false } = {}) {
        if (!currentStory) return
        if (!Theme.settings.autoSavePosition) return
        const chapter = currentChapter()
        if (!chapter) return
        const ratio = scrollRatio()
        ReaderLogic.saveProgress(currentStory.id, {
          chapterId: chapter.id,
          chapterIndex: currentChapterIndex,
          scrollRatio: ratio,
        })
        if (asDraft || Theme.settings.autoSavePosition) {
          ReaderLogic.saveDraft(currentStory.id, chapter.id, {
            contentHTML: buildChapterHTML(chapter),
            scrollRatio: ratio,
          })
        }
      }

      let scrollTimer = null
      content.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
        if (!readerActive || !currentStory) return

        const ratio = scrollRatio()
        viewer.setProgress(ratio)

        clearTimeout(scrollTimer)
        scrollTimer = setTimeout(() => saveReadingState(), 250)

        // Ẩn/hiện toolbar theo hướng cuộn
        if (Theme.settings.hideToolbar) {
          const dY = content.scrollTop - lastScrollTop
          if (dY > 10) document.body.classList.add('chrome-hidden')
          else if (dY < -10) document.body.classList.remove('chrome-hidden')
        }
        lastScrollTop = content.scrollTop

        // Tự sang chương tiếp khi cuộn hết chương
        if (Theme.settings.autoNextChapter && ratio > 0.985 && currentChapterIndex < currentStory.chapters.length - 1) {
          if (!pendingAutoNext) {
            pendingAutoNext = setTimeout(() => {
              pendingAutoNext = null
              nextChapter()
            }, 600)
          }
        } else if (pendingAutoNext && ratio <= 0.985) {
          clearTimeout(pendingAutoNext)
          pendingAutoNext = null
        }
      })

      // Chạm vào nội dung để hiện/ẩn thanh công cụ
      content.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
        if (!readerActive) return
        if (e.target.closest('a, button')) return
        if (!Theme.settings.hideToolbar) return
        document.body.classList.toggle('chrome-hidden')
      })

      function prevChapter() {
        if (currentChapterIndex <= 0) return
        saveReadingState({ asDraft: true })
        currentChapterIndex--
        renderChapter()
      }
      function nextChapter() {
        if (!currentStory || currentChapterIndex >= currentStory.chapters.length - 1) return
        saveReadingState({ asDraft: true })
        currentChapterIndex++
        renderChapter()
      }
      function exitReader() {
        saveReadingState({ asDraft: true })
        readerActive = false
        document.body.classList.remove('reading', 'chrome-hidden', 'chrome-shown')
        renderDetail()
      }

      // ---------- Điều hướng tab ----------
      const NAV_ID_MAP = { home: 'home', search: 'search', library: 'library', history: 'history', settings: 'settings', detail: 'home' }

      function renderNav(activeTab) {
        if (activeTab === 'reader') { navSlot.innerHTML = ''; return }
        const id = NAV_ID_MAP[activeTab] || activeTab || 'home'
        navSlot.innerHTML = renderBottomNav(id)
        navSlot.querySelectorAll('.bottom-nav-item').forEach((btn) => {
          btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
            const tab = btn.dataset.tab
            // Toggle: bấm lại chính nút đang active (trừ Trang chủ) → đóng, trở về Trang chủ
            if (tab !== 'home' && tab === currentTab) switchTab('home')
            else switchTab(tab)
          })
        })
      }

      function switchTab(tab, query) {
        if (readerActive && currentStory) {
          saveReadingState({ asDraft: true })
          readerActive = false
          document.body.classList.remove('reading', 'chrome-hidden', 'chrome-shown')
        }
        readerMenu.close()
        readerToc.close()
        adPopover.hide()

        if (tab === 'home') showHome()
        else if (tab === 'search') showSearch(query || '')
        else if (tab === 'library') showLibrary()
        else if (tab === 'history') showHistory()
        else if (tab === 'settings') showSettings()
      }

      // ---------- Khởi chạy ----------
      const deepId = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('s')
      if (deepId != null) {
        if (STORY_MAP.has(String(deepId))) openStory(String(deepId))
        else switchTab('home')
      } else {
        switchTab('home')
      }
    </script>
  
</body></html>
